items.name: Calgary Spring 2027
items.information:
Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, please arrive at least **15 minutes** before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.

## First-Time Competitors:
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) for a basic overview of the rules.

## Notice of Filming and Photography:
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Porterville Spring 2027

venue.name: Hillside Community Church
venue.address: 1091 W Linda Vista Avenue, Porterville, CA

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortervilleSpring2027#79300-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please. No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

items.name: Indiana Championship 2027

venue.name: The Commons
venue.details: Nugent-Custer Performance Hall on the 2nd floor

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA4MTk5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--eb570dfb9a740dbc378bc5fdfa55473c8cbdb768/Untitled%20-%20July%2025,%202026%20at%2008.35.43.png)
Competitors may bring in outside food & non alcoholic beverages.  There will not be any on site concessions available.  

The venue features a free indoor playground on the first floor for families.  There is a moving sculpture that runs in the lobby and can also be viewed from the competition floor.  

The venue is 100% ADA Accessible with elevators, escalators & stage ramps.  

The street parking and parking garage next door are all FREE on weekends.

Across the street from the venue you can find a Children's museum, Historical Ice Cream Parlor/Museum and various other stores & eateries.  There are chain restaurants scattered around the city.

Lodging:

The Hotel Indigo is just down from the venue and recently renovated.  Near the interstate are other hotel chain options.



This competition is being supported by Midwest Cubing Association.
